responsibility: Specializes the rs6000 AIX target for AIX 4.3. It defines AIX 4.3-specific option-override checks and diagnostics for 32/64-bit mode, PowerPC64 enablement, and soft-float versus long-double-128, selects assembler CPU mappings and defaults, sets the preprocessor builtins and C++ macro environment, disables AltiVec support for this OS level, and provides the AIX 4.3 library, linker, startup-file, type, init/fini, and deferred-.set policy needed to compile and link XCOFF binaries on that release.
